items.title: Stem Cell Therapeutics for Crohn's Disease
items.venue: National High School Journal of Science (NHSJS)
items.abstract: Current IBD treatments including biologics can reduce inflammation but often cannot achieve durable remission. This review summarizes regenerative and immune-modulating potential of stem cell approaches for Crohn's disease, including tissue repair themes, clinical-trial signals, limitations, and future directions. External journal content; IBDPal education only.
